thread.title: UPDATE: Dow falls nearly 300 points to start Thanksgiving week; Boeing delivers biggest blow to blue chips

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Dow falls nearly 300 points to start Thanksgiving week; Boeing delivers biggest blow to blue chips
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was sinking late-morning Monday, pressured by a decline in Boeing Co.'s stock (BA) to start the holiday-shortened week. Boeing shares were exacting a roughly 75-point toll from the price-weighted blue-chip gauge, which was trading 255 points, or 1%, at 25,154, at last check. The S&P 500 index declined 1% at 2,709, while the Nasdaq Composite Index lost 1.9% at 7,114, with a drop in shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) weighing on the broader market. The Wall Street Journal over the weekend reported that production slowdowns at iPhone maker were hurting its suppliers. Shares of Apple were down about 3.5%.
-Mark DeCambre; 1122ET
